findings.message: The total supply of 25,000,000 QFX is larger than the maximum supply of 21,212,121 QFX; a cap such as ERC20Capped at the maximum refuses a mint past it with ERC20ExceededCap.

basis.text: ERC20Capped fixes a cap on the total supply once, in its constructor, and a mint that would take the supply over the cap fails with the error ERC20ExceededCap.

basis.text: As long as a mint holds a mint authority, that authority may mint more at any time; SetAuthority can set it to None, and from then on the supply can never grow.
